start: Owner signed in to an online gym (not the demo gym) on its free trial with more than 14 days left; no lapse or renew notice showing

user_sees: One calm line at the top: "Free trial: <n> days left (ends <day month year>)"
must_not: The banner in the demo gym
Any page locked or greyed out
A date in another time zone than India

steps.action: Open other pages and come back to Today
must_not: A different number of days on the same day

start: Other kind: a gym that already pays for a MettleUp plan (monthly or yearly), 7 days or less before the paid-until day

user_sees: A strong line: "Your MettleUp plan is paid until <date>. Pay for the next month or year to keep going."
must_not: The free-trial words for a paying gym
A line for a lifetime plan

user_sees: The Pay MettleUp page in Settings
must_not: A page the owner cannot open

user_sees: The price list of the MettleUp website in a new tab
must_not: The admin app replaced by the website

steps.action: Open Today after the paid-until day has passed
user_sees: "Your MettleUp plan was paid until <date>. Pay to keep going. Your members’ app keeps working."
must_not: Members or the desk locked out

start: Owner on Today when the trial cannot be read: the internet is off, the gym server is older, or the gym is browser-only

user_sees: Today as usual with no trial line at all
must_not: An error box about the trial
A spinner that never ends
An old trial line from another gym

steps.action: Open Today in a gym with a lifetime plan
must_not: A request to pay

start: Owner of a trial gym, followed from 15 days left to after the end

user_sees: A strong line: "Free trial: 14 days left (ends <date>). Pick a MettleUp pack to keep going after that."
must_not: Still the calm line
No way to pay

steps.action: Open Today with 1 day left, then on the end day
must_not: "1 days left"
"0 days left"
A minus number

user_sees: "Your free trial ended on <date>. Pick a MettleUp pack to keep going. Your members’ app keeps working."
must_not: Any page locked
The members' app stopped

steps.action: Pay for a plan, HQ confirms it, open Today again
must_not: The "ended" line still there after a paid plan started

start: The same trial gym, a front-desk sign-in on a second device

user_sees: Today with no trial or payment line
must_not: The desk reading the gym's MettleUp plan, trial end or paid-until day

steps.action: The owner opens Today on his device
user_sees: After the end: the words "Your members’ app keeps working."
must_not: Anything locked after the trial ends (the banner is words only)
The line shown to members
